dominant_strengths: Hero photography is beautifully lit with a gradient backdrop that ties the orange iPhone to the warm spill light
Typography hierarchy uses Apple's signature SF stack with confident weight contrast between headline and CTA
Strong native Apple feel: pill button, blue link affordance, and rounded card containers feel system-authentic
dominant_weaknesses: Awkward vertical rhythm between hero and 'Why Apple' section leaves a large dead zone with the floating Shop link orphaned right
The 'Shop iPhone' link sits oddly far from its headline, breaking the read order and weakening the CTA pairing
Cards at the bottom are clipped mid-sentence creating an unintentional crop rather than a designed scroll tease
fix_priorities: Rebalance the headline/Shop iPhone pairing — anchor the link directly under or beside the headline for clearer hierarchy
Tighten vertical spacing between hero and section heading; the gap currently reads as a layout error
Design the card row crop intentionally with a gradient fade or aligned baseline rather than hard mid-text cut
Consider a subtler hero gradient so the orange product pops without competing with the tonal background shift
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral hero imagery carries the page while behavioral clarity suffers from misaligned CTAs and reflective payoff is generic Apple-marketing familiar.
rationale.intent_fit: It reads convincingly as an Apple iPhone landing scroll but contributes little beyond replicating existing apple.com conventions.
